runtimePayloadPrerequisite.members: Exact path map: sha256,bytes,package,version,architecture=x64,license,notices[] and sourceDisposition{mode:none-required|corresponding-source,url+sha256 when required}. Members restricted to runtime/,licenses/ or explicit sibling helper role paths. Metadata self-hash excluded; root supplies approved manifest digest separately.

Both must match members exactly. No second format assembled by workflow owner.
runtimePayloadPrerequisite.recordManifestScope: Static byte inventory only: explicit description lists every real file/package/architecture/notice/source obligation, helpers/system DLLs/dynamic dependencies. This fills exact hashes/bytes and collector aliases then validates; root must approve resulting RUNTIME digest separately. No download/install/VM/native execution and no automatic complete-inventory claim.
runtimePayloadPrerequisite.actualClosure: All static normal/delay imports across shipped service/helper/tool PEs must resolve to declared runtime/bin DLLs or explicit allowlisted Windows system DLLs. Actual extra dependencies/tool support files unknown until approved inventory supplied. Declared dynamic dependencies must resolve inside payload or be explicit optional external feature dependencies.
runtimePayloadPrerequisite.notImplicit: No GUI fonts/fontconfig install, provider install, foreign Cygwin/Git Bash lookup, CAD runtime rebundle or Browser extras. Old0-DLL ZIP does not satisfy this input.

signing.owner: Root-approved protected native signer/orchestration; Windows producer verifies, never provisions certificates
signing.requiredDecision: Root release freeze chooses authenticode or unsigned-portable-allowed. Unsigned portable packaging preserves exact compiled bytes and records signed:false; final runtime, sandbox and resident lifecycle gates remain required.
signing.order: Compile emits unsigned-service.exe reference and service PE. Authorized signer signs backplane-serve.exe before packaging; explicit sibling helper binaries must already be signed before their runtime payload digest is approved. Never mutate unsigned-service.exe.
signing.verification: authenticode packaging checks unchanged unsigned content except PE checksum/security table and certificate append, then actual Windows Get-AuthenticodeSignature Valid plus approved thumbprint for service and owned helper roles. This verifies signatures only, not public/product readiness.
signing.internalOnlyAlternative: --signing-policy unsigned-internal requires unchanged compiled bytes and records publicEligible=false; cannot satisfy final signed release gates or be relabeled public.
signing.portableAlternative: --signing-policy unsigned-portable-allowed is available only through the explicit root portable release policy; no certificate is required. It does not itself mark the payload publicEligible or runtime accepted.
